queries_run: eBay market share gaining OR losing 2026
eBay competitor threat Temu Shein Vinted Whatnot 2026 GMV share

findings.claim: eBay 10-K 列出競爭來源包含傳統零售、電商、直播商務、搜尋、社群與 AI 工具（agents、chatbots）；並稱進入門檻低，專業型對手在 Focus Categories 可能比 eBay 更快滿足社群需求。
findings.excerpt: The barriers to competition are low – Competitors can easily launch their own platforms at nominal cost by using commercially available software or partnering with successful ecommerce, search, advertising or social media companies.

findings.claim: 10-K 揭露 eBay 依賴 Google 搜尋導流，Alphabet 演算法調整曾減少導流，且若未獲足夠 AI 轉介，買賣家可能轉向其他平台。
findings.excerpt: If we fail for any reason to receive sufficient AI referrals to our platforms, or to build, license or acquire the AI technology capabilities that matter to our buyers and sellers, our buyers and sellers or both may choose alternatives to eBay

clues.claim: 英國 CMA 估計 Vinted 占英國 C2C 服飾 GMV 50-60%，eBay 與 Depop 流失份額。
clues.source: Value Added Resource: CMA Puts Vinted At 50-60% Of UK C2C Apparel GMV As eBay, Depop Lost Share

clues.claim: eBay Q2 2026 GMV 年增 15%（德國產業站報導，未對照官方）。

competitive_share_entrants.note: 搜尋僅得二手聚合與估計，無權威 2026 美國份額消長數據；10-K 為一手。
